* Attribute is an abtract base class for completing the specification of some {@link * Transform}. * *

Attribute is either in Type/Value format or Type/Length/Value format. For TV format, * Attribute length is always 4 bytes containing value for 2 bytes. While for TLV format, * Attribute length is determined by length field. * *

Currently only Key Length type is supported * * @see RFC 7296, Internet Key * Exchange Protocol Version 2 (IKEv2)

variables.name: ATTRIBUTE_TYPE_KEY_LENGTH
variables.comment: Support only one Attribute type: Key Length. Should use Type/Value format.

variables.name: ATTRIBUTE_FORMAT_MASK
variables.comment: Mask to extract the left most AF bit to indicate Attribute Format.

variables.name: ATTRIBUTE_TYPE_MASK
variables.comment: Mask to extract 15 bits after the AF bit to indicate Attribute Type.

variables.name: ATTRIBUTE_FORMAT_TV
variables.comment: Package private mask to indicate that Type-Value (TV) Attribute Format is used.

variables.name: type
variables.comment: Only Key Length type belongs to AttributeType

methods.name: static Pair<Attribute, Integer> readFrom(ByteBuffer inputBuffer) throws IkeProtocolException

methodNames: static Pair<Attribute, Integer> readFrom(ByteBuffer inputBuffer) throws IkeProtocolException
